The '''1941 National Division''' was the fifth edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] won their first title.

==Participants==
*[[Eskişehir Demirspor]] - [[Eskişehir Football League]] and 1940 [[Turkish Football Championship]] winners
*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[İstanbulspor]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[Gençlerbirliği S.K.|Gençlerbirliği]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[Harp Okulu S.K.|Harp Okulu]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*Maskespor - [[Ankara Football League]], 3rd
*[[Altay S.K.|Altay]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[Altınordu F.K.|Altınordu]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
